masterpieces.title: Wheat Field with Cypresses
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: Painted at the Saint-Rémy asylum in 1889; Van Gogh considered it one of his best summer landscapes.

masterpieces.title: Madame X
masterpieces.creator: John Singer Sargent
masterpieces.story: The 1884 society portrait whose fallen dress strap caused a scandal that drove Sargent from Paris.

masterpieces.title: Self-Portrait with a Straw Hat
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: Painted in Paris, 1887, practicing on his own face while short on money for models.

masterpieces.title: Bridge over a Pond of Water Lilies
masterpieces.creator: Claude Monet
masterpieces.story: The Japanese footbridge at Giverny in full summer green, 1899.

masterpieces.title: Cow's Skull: Red, White, and Blue
masterpieces.creator: Georgia O'Keeffe
masterpieces.story: 1931; a desert skull framed like a national emblem, O'Keeffe's answer to the men painting the 'Great American Thing'.

masterpieces.title: The Steerage
masterpieces.creator: Alfred Stieglitz
masterpieces.story: 1907; passengers on a ship's lower deck, the photograph Stieglitz called his best, and the moment photography argued itself into art.

masterpieces.title: The Starry Night
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: Painted from the asylum window at Saint-Rémy in 1889, the swirling night sky he saw before sunrise, from memory and imagination.

masterpieces.title: Water Lilies
masterpieces.creator: Claude Monet
masterpieces.story: A room-wrapping triptych from Giverny, painted in Monet's final years.

masterpieces.title: Lobster Trap and Fish Tail
masterpieces.creator: Alexander Calder
masterpieces.medium: Painted steel wire and sheet metal
masterpieces.story: Calder's 1939 hanging mobile, made for MoMA's stairwell, drifting shapes balanced in mid-air.

masterpieces.title: The Birth of the World
masterpieces.creator: Joan Miró
masterpieces.story: 1925; poured and brushed grounds with a few floating signs, Miró called it a kind of genesis, painting invented from almost nothing.

masterpieces.title: Calder's Circus
masterpieces.creator: Alexander Calder
masterpieces.story: A miniature circus Calder performed by hand in 1920s Paris.

masterpieces.title: Summer Days
masterpieces.creator: Georgia O'Keeffe
masterpieces.story: 1936; a deer skull floating above the New Mexico desert with a band of wildflowers, life and bone in one hovering image.

masterpieces.title: Comtesse d'Haussonville
masterpieces.creator: Jean-Auguste-Dominique Ingres
masterpieces.story: 1845; the sly sideways glance and impossible reflected arm.

masterpieces.title: Woman with a Parasol
masterpieces.creator: Claude Monet
masterpieces.story: Madame Monet and son Jean on a windy hill, 1875.

masterpieces.title: Self-Portrait
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: Painted at Saint-Rémy in 1889, one of his last self-portraits.

masterpieces.title: A Girl with a Watering Can
masterpieces.creator: Auguste Renoir
masterpieces.story: 1876; one of the most beloved Impressionist children in art.

masterpieces.title: The Farm
masterpieces.creator: Joan Miró
masterpieces.story: 1921–22; every detail of his family's Catalan farmhouse, painted blade by blade. Hemingway bought it and said it held everything Spain makes you feel.

masterpieces.title: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte
masterpieces.creator: Georges Seurat
masterpieces.story: 1884–86; millions of dots, two years of work, and the founding image of pointillism.

masterpieces.title: The Bedroom
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: The Arles bedroom, 1889, one of three versions Van Gogh painted of his own room.

masterpieces.title: Paris Street; Rainy Day
masterpieces.creator: Gustave Caillebotte
masterpieces.story: 1877; umbrellas, cobblestones, and the boldest cropping in Impressionism.

masterpieces.title: Two Sisters (On the Terrace)
masterpieces.creator: Auguste Renoir
masterpieces.story: 1881; the sitters weren't actually sisters, but the sunlight is real.

masterpieces.title: Sky Above Clouds IV
masterpieces.creator: Georgia O'Keeffe
masterpieces.story: 1965; clouds from an airplane window, 24 feet wide, painted in her late seventies.

masterpieces.title: Van Gogh's Self-Portrait Dedicated to Paul Gauguin
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: 1888; painted as a gift in the fateful Arles autumn.

masterpieces.title: Irises
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: Painted in his first week at the Saint-Rémy asylum, 1889; once the most expensive painting ever sold.

masterpieces.title: Wheatstacks, Snow Effect, Morning
masterpieces.creator: Claude Monet
masterpieces.story: 1891; winter light from the famous haystack series.

masterpieces.title: Calla Lily
masterpieces.creator: Robert Mapplethorpe
masterpieces.story: 1988; a single flower lit like sculpture. The Getty and LACMA jointly hold Mapplethorpe's art and archive.

masterpieces.title: The Daughters of Edward Darley Boit
masterpieces.creator: John Singer Sargent
masterpieces.story: 1882; four sisters in shadowed Paris rooms, flanked by the actual Japanese vases in the painting.

masterpieces.title: Where Do We Come From? What Are We? Where Are We Going?
masterpieces.creator: Paul Gauguin
masterpieces.story: Gauguin's 1897–98 Tahitian summa, he considered it his masterpiece.

masterpieces.title: Where Do We Come From?
masterpieces.creator: Paul Gauguin
masterpieces.story: Also see the Egyptian Old Kingdom pair statue nearby.

masterpieces.title: Renoir's Dance at Bougival
masterpieces.creator: Auguste Renoir
masterpieces.story: 1883; the whirling couple that anchors the Impressionist wing.

masterpieces.title: El Jaleo
masterpieces.creator: John Singer Sargent
masterpieces.story: The flamenco dancer in her own Spanish-arch alcove.

masterpieces.title: The Large Bathers
masterpieces.creator: Paul Cézanne
masterpieces.story: 1898–1905; the grand finale of Cézanne's bather obsession.

masterpieces.title: Sunflowers
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: One of the series lives in Philadelphia.

masterpieces.title: 181 Renoirs
masterpieces.creator: Auguste Renoir
masterpieces.story: Dr. Barnes bought Renoir and Cézanne by the roomful; the salon-style hangs are his own eccentric design.

masterpieces.title: The Card Players
masterpieces.creator: Paul Cézanne
masterpieces.story: One of the five versions; another sold privately for over $250 million.

masterpieces.title: Seurat's Models
masterpieces.creator: Georges Seurat
masterpieces.story: The pointillist nudes posed before his own Grande Jatte.

masterpieces.title: Monet's Weeping Willow
masterpieces.creator: Claude Monet
masterpieces.story: 1918–19; grief for WWI in paint.

masterpieces.title: Portrait of Estelle Musson Degas
masterpieces.creator: Edgar Degas
masterpieces.story: Painted while Degas lived with family in New Orleans in 1872, the only French Impressionist with an American hometown chapter.

masterpieces.title: Liberty Leading the People
masterpieces.creator: Eugène Delacroix
masterpieces.story: 1830; the bare-breasted Republic on the barricades, France's revolutionary self-image.

masterpieces.title: Grande Odalisque
masterpieces.creator: Jean-Auguste-Dominique Ingres
masterpieces.story: 1814; anatomically impossible spine, deliberately, beauty over accuracy.

masterpieces.title: Starry Night Over the Rhône
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: Arles, 1888, gaslight and stars on the river, a year before The Starry Night.

masterpieces.title: Bal du moulin de la Galette
masterpieces.creator: Auguste Renoir
masterpieces.story: 1876; dappled Sunday sunlight in Montmartre, Impressionism at its happiest.

masterpieces.title: Luncheon on the Grass
masterpieces.creator: Édouard Manet
masterpieces.story: The 1863 scandal that launched modern painting, a nude picnicking with dressed men.

masterpieces.title: Olympia
masterpieces.creator: Édouard Manet
masterpieces.story: 1863; the courtesan whose direct stare outraged Paris.

masterpieces.title: Whistler's Mother
masterpieces.creator: James McNeill Whistler
masterpieces.story: 1871; officially 'Arrangement in Grey and Black No. 1'.

masterpieces.title: The Church at Auvers
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: June 1890, weeks before his death, the sky an impossible blue-black.

masterpieces.title: Little Dancer Aged Fourteen
masterpieces.creator: Edgar Degas
masterpieces.story: The only sculpture Degas ever exhibited; critics in 1881 called her ugly, she outlived them all.

masterpieces.title: Blue Water Lilies
masterpieces.creator: Claude Monet
masterpieces.story: Giverny dissolving into pure color.

masterpieces.title: Water Lilies Cycle
masterpieces.creator: Claude Monet
masterpieces.story: Monet's gift to France after WWI, two oval rooms he designed himself as 'a haven of peaceful meditation'.

masterpieces.title: Young Girls at the Piano
masterpieces.creator: Auguste Renoir
masterpieces.story: 1892; domestic sweetness done masterfully.

masterpieces.title: Impression, Sunrise
masterpieces.creator: Claude Monet
masterpieces.story: The 1872 harbor sketch whose mocking review named Impressionism itself.

masterpieces.title: Monet's Late Giverny Canvases
masterpieces.creator: Claude Monet
masterpieces.story: Wisteria and weeping willows from the painter's own bequest.

masterpieces.title: The Fighting Temeraire
masterpieces.creator: J.M.W. Turner
masterpieces.story: 1839; the old warship towed to scrap at sunset, voted Britain's favorite painting.

masterpieces.title: Bathers at Asnières
masterpieces.creator: Georges Seurat
masterpieces.story: 1884; Seurat's first great canvas, working-class leisure at monumental scale.

masterpieces.title: A Bar at the Folies-Bergère
masterpieces.creator: Édouard Manet
masterpieces.story: 1882; Manet's last great painting, the barmaid's reflection doesn't quite add up, on purpose.

masterpieces.title: Self-Portrait with Bandaged Ear
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: January 1889, weeks after the razor incident in Arles.

masterpieces.title: Female Nude
masterpieces.creator: Amedeo Modigliani
masterpieces.story: 1916; from the show the police shut down.

masterpieces.title: The Turner Watercolours
masterpieces.creator: J.M.W. Turner
masterpieces.story: Shown only each January, by the donor's strict wish.

masterpieces.title: Almond Blossom
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: 1890; painted for his newborn nephew, the family kept it over the piano for decades.

masterpieces.title: The Potato Eaters
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: 1885; the dark, earthy work he considered his first masterpiece.

masterpieces.title: Wheatfield with Crows
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: July 1890; stormy sky, three paths, painted in his final weeks.

masterpieces.title: Self-Portrait with Grey Felt Hat
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: 1887; Paris period, where he found his color.

masterpieces.title: Café Terrace at Night
masterpieces.creator: Vincent van Gogh
masterpieces.story: 1888; the Arles café under a starry sky, no black anywhere in the night.

masterpieces.title: Le Chahut
masterpieces.creator: Georges Seurat
masterpieces.story: 1890; the cancan in dots.

masterpieces.title: The Monk by the Sea
masterpieces.creator: Caspar David Friedrich
masterpieces.story: 1808–10; a tiny figure before an immense empty sea, Romanticism distilled.

masterpieces.title: Abbey among Oak Trees
masterpieces.creator: Caspar David Friedrich
masterpieces.story: The Monk's somber twin, hung beside it.

masterpieces.title: Monet's The Luncheon
masterpieces.creator: Claude Monet
masterpieces.story: 1868; family breakfast before Impressionism had a name.

masterpieces.title: The Kiss
masterpieces.creator: Gustav Klimt
masterpieces.medium: Oil and gold leaf on canvas
masterpieces.story: 1907–08; the golden embrace, Austria's national painting, in a Baroque palace.

masterpieces.title: The Scream (versions)
masterpieces.creator: Edvard Munch
masterpieces.story: Munch left Oslo everything in his will; the versions rotate on display to protect them from light.

masterpieces.title: The Scream
masterpieces.creator: Edvard Munch
masterpieces.story: The famous 1893 version, stolen in 1994 during the Lillehammer Olympics and recovered.
